# Tolulope Olatunji — Digital Transformation Consultant & Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Tolulope Olatunji (also written Olatunji Tolulope), a digital transformation consultant based in Nigeria with a software engineering background (React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, AWS) and 4+ years of professional experience. Helps businesses and organisations understand their problems, redesign their processes and build the software that supports them. Currently deputy technical authority on a national government regulatory platform serving 58,000+ registered professionals.

## Location

- Based in Nigeria; works with clients across Africa and worldwide, on-site or remotely

## Skills

- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB (Mongoose), REST, GraphQL, WebSockets
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, ECS/Fargate, CloudFront, S3), GitHub Actions CI/CD, release management
- Quality & Safety: regression testing, fail-closed design, incident response, data-protection compliance (NDPA 2023)
- AI Engineering: AI-augmented development with Claude Code — agentic workflows and AI code review wired into CI

## Services

- Digital transformation consulting: understanding the problem, mapping and redesigning business processes
- Process automation and custom software that fits the way a team works
- Full-stack web application development (React/Next.js + Node/NestJS)
- Payment integration and transaction-integrity engineering
- Cloud deployment, CI/CD pipelines and release management on AWS
- Production operations: monitoring, incident response and data remediation
